chunks: As for what Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim narrated from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams) عليهما السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who performed the obligatory tawaf in eight circuits. He said: He should add six more to it.

key_terms.ثَمَانِيَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ: eight circuits, exceeding the prescribed count
key_terms.سِتَّةً: six additional circuits to complete the ruling
key_terms.طَوَافَ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory tawaf required in the ritual
key_terms.يُضِيفُ: he adds; he should append more circuits

ai.seo_question: What should someone do if he performs eight circuits in the obligatory tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who performs eight circuits in the obligatory tawaf instead of the prescribed number. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that six more circuits be added, so the act is completed in a legally recognized manner.
